**The workflow**

What are you trying to do, and what gets in the way today?

**Proposed behavior**

Give one concrete before/after example. Describe the outcome rather than only
the implementation you have in mind.

**Constraints and alternatives**

Mention relevant client support, local/offline needs, privacy, cost, platform or
compatibility constraints. Include an existing workaround if you have one.
Use synthetic examples instead of private project memory.

Check the [roadmap and current scope](https://github.com/CharlieJamesGwapo/project-memory-mcp#roadmap)
and [existing issues](https://github.com/CharlieJamesGwapo/project-memory-mcp/issues)
for related work.
